name: enclosure-body
use: An open-top hollow box enclosure body, optionally with a 2x2 corner screw-boss pattern for a lid. Use for electronics cases, project boxes, and any body that needs walls and a floor but no lid.

params.corner_r: mm outer corner fillet radius (0 = sharp)
params.add_bosses: bool, union a 2x2 corner screw-boss pattern onto the floor
params.boss_margin: mm inset of each boss center from the outer corner
params.boss_h: mm boss height measured from Z=0

name: lid-sliding
use: A sliding dovetail lid: the tongue IS the lid, flush with the box top, sliding along +Y into a dovetail_groove cut into the mating enclosure body's top edge. Use when the lid should not be liftable straight off (retains itself once slid closed).

params.box_width: mm outer box width (must match the mating body's width)
params.wall: mm box wall thickness (must match the mating body's wall)
params.lid_length: mm lid length along the slide direction (+Y)
params.dovetail_angle: degrees from vertical (default 55; keep >= 45 for printability)
params.clearance: mm per-side clearance for smooth sliding (0.05 for a snug fit)

name: lid-snap
use: A flat snap-fit lid with cantilever snap_hook_clip features on the underside near two opposing edges. Mates with snap_socket_receiver slots cut into the enclosure body's walls. Use when the lid should snap on and off by hand without tools.

params.lid_width: mm outer lid width (X), matches the enclosure body's outer width
params.lid_depth: mm outer lid depth (Y), matches the enclosure body's outer depth
params.corner_r: mm outer corner fillet radius (0 = sharp)
params.clip_inset: mm inset of each clip's beam origin from the panel edge
params.clip_embed_mm: mm the clip base embeds into the panel for a real volumetric overlap

name: lid-screwed
use: A flat lid with a 2x2 corner counterbore pattern so a screw head sits flush with the top face and the shaft passes into the mating enclosure body's screw_boss (or heat_set_boss) pattern below. Use when the lid must be removable with a screwdriver and sealed under load.

params.lid_width: mm outer lid width (X), matches the enclosure body's outer width
params.lid_depth: mm outer lid depth (Y), matches the enclosure body's outer depth
params.corner_r: mm outer corner fillet radius (0 = sharp)
params.hole_margin: mm inset of each hole center from the outer corner (match boss_margin)

name: adapter-ring-flanged
use: A stepped cylindrical bore adapter with a flat mounting flange drilled with a bolt-circle pattern. Use to adapt between two circular fittings of different diameter: pipe couplers, lens/filter adapters, motor-to-shaft collars, vacuum-port reducers.

params.bore_d: mm through-bore diameter (the smaller mating fitting)
params.body_d: mm cylindrical body outer diameter (the larger mating fitting)
params.bolt_circle_d: mm bolt-circle diameter for the flange mounting holes
params.bolt_count: count of mounting holes evenly spaced on the bolt circle

name: l-bracket-gusset
use: An L-shaped bracket: two rectangular arms meeting at a right angle, each drilled with a mounting-screw clearance hole, reinforced by a diagonal gusset rib across the inner corner. Use for wall/shelf mounts and right-angle structural brackets.

params.arm_a_len: mm length of the vertical arm (Z)
params.arm_b_len: mm length of the horizontal arm (X)
params.gusset_t: mm gusset thickness (Y, centered in the arm width)
params.gusset_reach: mm how far the gusset extends along each arm from the inner corner
params.hole_inset: mm inset of each hole center from its arm's free end

name: plate-boss-pattern
use: A flat rectangular plate with a regular grid of screw bosses (standoffs) unioned onto the top face. Use for mounting a PCB or a panel of components; combine with vent_grid or port_cutout for enclosure-adjacent plates.

params.corner_r: mm outer corner fillet radius (0 = sharp)
params.boss_h: mm standoff height above the plate top face

name: hook
use: A flat wall-mount backplate with two screw clearance holes and a curved round-rod arm curling out and back from the front face to retain a hung item. Use for coat hooks, cable hooks, and tool hangers.

params.hook_arm_r: mm centerline radius of the hook arm's curve
params.hook_tube_d: mm hook arm cross-section (round rod) diameter
params.hook_sweep_deg: degrees the arm curls away from its pivot
params.hook_pivot_z: mm pivot height on the backplate (Z)
params.mount_hole_inset: mm inset of each mounting hole from the backplate's top/bottom edge

name: clip
use: A U-shaped spring clip: a solid closed base at one end with two parallel arms extending from it, separated by a gap sized to grip a panel or rail edge by friction/spring-back. Use for cable clips, panel edge trim, badge clips, and rail-mount clips.

params.clip_width: mm clip width (X, constant along the whole clip)
params.gap_mm: mm inner gap the clip grips (panel/rail thickness + a small squeeze)
params.wall_t: mm wall thickness (also the closed base thickness at the bend)
params.arm_len: mm straight arm length beyond the closed base, on each side

name: stand
use: A wedge-shaped base with a flat vertical back section and a sloped front ramp, with a slot cut into the flat back section that holds a flat device at a fixed viewing angle. Use for phone stands, tablet stands, and card/photo holders.

params.base_d: mm base footprint depth (Y), back edge to front edge
params.base_h: mm base height at the back (Z)
params.back_flat_w: mm depth of the flat vertical back section that holds the slot
params.slot_w: mm slot width (X), slightly less than base_w
params.slot_gap: mm slot opening width (device thickness + clearance)
params.slot_depth: mm how far the slot cuts down into the back section from the top

name: gridfinity-bin
use: A Gridfinity storage bin: feet on the 42 mm grid, walls, cavity, and stacking lip, with optional dividers, label shelf, finger scoop, and magnet/screw pockets. Use for any request naming Gridfinity, or for a drawer/toolbox insert that must interoperate with an existing Gridfinity grid. For custom tool-shaped pockets, call gridfinity_bin(solid=True) and cut the pockets into the blank instead.

params.cols: count grid units (U) in X, 42 mm each
params.rows: count grid units (U) in Y, 42 mm each
params.label_tab: bool, sloped label shelf on the +Y wall
params.scoop: bool, swept quarter-round at the -Y wall
params.magnet_holes: bool, four 6.5x2.4 mm magnet pockets per cell
params.screw_holes: bool, four M3 screw holes per cell

name: gridfinity-baseplate
use: A Gridfinity baseplate: a grid of sockets that Gridfinity bins drop into, 42 mm per cell so plates tile edge to edge. Use when the request asks for the grid/base/tray the bins sit in, rather than the bins themselves.

params.cols: count grid units (U) in X, 42 mm each
params.rows: count grid units (U) in Y, 42 mm each
params.plate_h: mm total plate thickness (>= 7.15 to fit magnet pockets)
params.clearance: mm socket clearance around a bin foot, per side
params.magnet_holes: bool, four 6.5x2.4 mm magnet pockets per cell
params.screw_holes: bool, four M3 through-holes per cell
